semantic_definition: Primary key identifying one future OD-005 amendment test obligation
validation_rule: NOT NULL; matches pattern OD005-AMD-\d{3}; must not collide with any test_id in MODEL_3B_NUMERICAL_TEST_INVENTORY.csv or MODEL_3B_AMENDMENT_TEST_INVENTORY.csv

semantic_definition: The frozen OD-005 amendment operation that gave rise to this test obligation
validation_rule: must resolve to an existing row in WAVE_2_OD_005_EXACT_AMENDMENT_OPERATIONS.csv

semantic_definition: Free-text citation of the exact frozen requirement or additive-text ID this test verifies
validation_rule: must cite an existing ATX-*/frozen-document reference; nonblank

allowed_values: SCHEMA_VALIDATION,VALIDATOR_BEHAVIOR,MATHEMATICAL_INVARIANCE,CROSS_REFERENCE_INTEGRITY (existing values only; no new value may be introduced without separate schema adjudication)
semantic_definition: The category of check this test performs
validation_rule: must be one of the 4 values already observed in WAVE_2_OD_005_EXACT_TEST_OBLIGATIONS.csv

semantic_definition: Description of the synthetic fixture a future execution turn would construct to run this test; not itself a fixture or executable artifact
validation_rule: nonblank; must state the fixture is synthetic/future, not derived from historical data

semantic_definition: The positive condition this test verifies once executed
The failure condition this test would catch; may be N/A for a pure positive-path test (e.g. OD005-AMD-001, whose negative counterpart is a separate test ID)
validation_rule: if not applicable, must explicitly state which sibling test ID covers the negative case, not left blank

allowed_values: NO (only -- this inventory records no test that uses historical data, consistent with Phase D DO NOT RERUN and historical inference NOT_AUTHORIZED)
semantic_definition: Whether this test's fixture or execution would use historical corpus data
validation_rule: must equal NO for all 8 rows in this inventory

semantic_definition: The lifecycle status of this test obligation
validation_rule: must equal PLANNED_ONLY for all 8 rows; any other value requires a separate, explicitly authorized status-transition turn

allowed_values: E1 (post-documentation-amendment, separately authorized); E3 (post-validator-implementation, separately authorized); E4 (post-ledger-update, separately authorized) -- existing values only
semantic_definition: The OD-005 amendment subwave whose separate authorization and execution is a precondition for actually running this test
validation_rule: must cite an existing, defined subwave (E1/E3/E4); must not claim the referenced subwave has already executed
